I.value_zh: Bridgeflow 的规则、目录、frontmatter、Git、工作区与事件账本；仅有原文列出的基线快查，完整审计证据快照未提供。
I.value_en: Bridgeflow rules, directories, front matter, Git, workspace and event-ledger facts; only the source baseline scan is provided, not a complete audit evidence snapshot.
I.notes_zh: 明确目标为 D:\Bridgeflow，不将 TASK-003 的 Codeflow 结论迁移至本案。
I.notes_en: Target is explicitly D:\Bridgeflow; TASK-003 Codeflow conclusions are not transferred.

O.value_zh: FCoP carrier 中的 Bridgeflow 分级合规报告，含 P0/P1/P2、绿区和逐条事实出处。
O.value_en: A Bridgeflow graded compliance report in the FCoP carrier, including P0/P1/P2, green zone and per-finding provenance.
O.notes_en: The report is not treated as generated.

A.value_zh: 对正确目标 Bridgeflow 执行十一章只读审计，抽样检查命名与 frontmatter，并在 FCoP carrier 出具报告、归档 TASK-003/004。
A.value_en: Perform an eleven-section read-only audit of the correct Bridgeflow target, sample names and front matter, issue a report in FCoP carrier, and archive TASK-003/004.
A.notes_zh: 审定不执行跨项目访问、归档或 Git 操作。
A.notes_en: Adjudication executes no cross-project access, archive or Git operation.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 指令；FCoP 中的 ME 执行；ME 未被授予 Bridgeflow 角色。
P.value_en: ADMIN directs; ME in FCoP performs; ME is not granted a Bridgeflow role.
P.notes_zh: 不由 ME、ADMIN 或项目关系推导权限。
P.notes_en: No authority is inferred from ME, ADMIN or project relationship.

R.value_zh: P1、低风险、只读、无副作用、无需回滚；抽样规则为各目录头5/尾5/中间随机5；无截止时间。
R.value_en: P1, low risk, read-only, no side effects, no rollback; sampling is first 5/last 5/random 5 per directory; no deadline.

V.value_zh: Rule 0.c、Rule 5、Rule 7.5、Rule 4/4.5/6、SOP v2 问题7以及 fcop_audit/fcop_check 引用。
V.value_en: Rule 0.c, Rule 5, Rule 7.5, Rules 4/4.5/6, SOP v2 problem 7, and fcop_audit/fcop_check references.
V.notes_zh: 仅保留引用，不验证外部规则。
V.notes_en: References retained; external rules not verified.

C.value_zh: 报告必须完成 A–K、按四级输出并附事实出处，同时归档两个任务；缺少完整 Bridgeflow 证据使具体结论与验收不可判定。
C.value_en: The report must complete A–K, use four output sections with provenance, and archive two tasks; missing complete Bridgeflow evidence makes concrete findings and completion undecidable.
C.notes_zh: 基线快查不是 A–K 的完整证据。
C.notes_en: Baseline scan is not complete A–K evidence.

B.value_zh: 不得写入 Bridgeflow，不得读任务/报告/问题正文，不得删除或改写 TASK-003 历史，不得产生副作用。
B.value_en: Do not write Bridgeflow, read task/report/issue bodies, delete or rewrite TASK-003 history, or cause side effects.
B.notes_zh: 历史修正以新序号追加。
B.notes_en: History correction is append-only with a new sequence.
